package.config.branchProtection: Controls whether to query repository rules for GitHub repositories
package.config.gitAuthentication: Controls whether to enable automatic GitHub authentication for git commands within VS Code.
package.config.gitProtocol: Controls which protocol is used to clone a GitHub repository
package.config.showAvatar: Controls whether to show the GitHub avatar of the commit author in various hovers (ex: Git blame, Timeline, Source Control Graph, etc.)
